snippet.title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Visit the website: https://teamninja-studio.com/wolong2/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=AnnounceUKEU&utm_id=Caption

The highly anticipated sequel to the dark Three Kingdoms action RPG, Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember, is coming to XBOX Series X|S, PlayStation®5, Nintendo Switch™2, XBOX on PC, and Steam® in early 2027.

Follow us: 
X: https://x.com/koeitecmoeurope
Official Wo Long X: https://x.com/WoLongOfficial
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/koeitecmoeurope
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/koeitecmogames
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/KTEurope

*Screens are taken from an in-development version.
